_note: Draft placement action plan for CSE (Data Science). Targets are proposals for HOD approval — edit this file and re-run tools/build-data.js to publish. Baselines are the verified numbers from files/PLACEMENT ANALYSIS.xlsx.
owner: Dr. Sumithra Devi K A (Head) · Placement Coordinator: Mr. S R V Prasad Reddy

initiatives.action: Daily 90-minute aptitude + DSA drill from semester 4; weekly timed assessment with score tracking on the dashboard.
initiatives.metric: 80% of eligible batch clearing AMCAT / CoCubes cut-off

initiatives.action: Two-pass review (technical + language) of every resume, LinkedIn and GitHub profile; one-page data-project portfolio template issued.
initiatives.metric: 100% resumes reviewed and signed off before first drive

initiatives.action: Three rounds per student: technical (SQL / ML / Python), case (analytics), HR. Panel includes alumni working in analytics roles.
Add 15 analytics / product firms (Tredence, Sigmoid, Mu Sigma, LatentView, Tiger Analytics, PhonePe, Zerodha-class) via alumni and industry-cell referrals; two MoUs per semester.
initiatives.metric: 45 companies on campus, ≥ 20 from analytics / product

initiatives.action: Mandatory 6-week summer internship after semester 4 and 6-month internship in semester 8; track offer conversion as a first-class metric.
initiatives.metric: 45 internships secured, ≥ 30% converting to full-time offers

initiatives.action: Alumni connect session each semester, referral tracker with 20 target referrals per cycle, and a standing alumni-mentor pool.
initiatives.metric: 20 referrals per cycle, ≥ 5 converting to interviews

initiatives.action: Sponsored certification slots (AWS Cloud Practitioner, Azure DP-900, Google Advanced Data Analytics, Databricks Associate) prioritised by attendance and aptitude scores.
Separate GATE / GRE mentoring track from semester 5, weekly problem sessions, and application support for GATE, GRE and CAT aspirants.
Monthly review of this dashboard (placement %, recruiter mix, offer quality, IA/aptitude correlation) in the department meeting; actions logged against owners.
initiatives.metric: 12 reviews per year, minutes circulated within 48 hours

initiatives.action: Students below 75% attendance or below cut-off aptitude scores are routed to remediation before being allowed to sit for drives; parents informed where needed.
initiatives.metric: Zero students debarred for attendance at the first drive

timeline.milestone: Aptitude baseline tests, resume sign-off, mock round 1, first 10 recruiters added
Main placement season: analytics and IT-services drives, mock round 2
Internship conversions, off-campus pipeline, second drive window, mock round 3
Backlog clearing, result-awaiting cases, final placement report for the AY
